findings.title: A session role can leak between pooled borrowers
findings.why_it_matters: A request that changes the PostgreSQL session role and returns its connection can leave that role in the alias-wide pool; a later wrapper can receive the same session with the prior role. This can cross tenant or privilege boundaries in applications that use session-level role switching.
findings.suggested_fix: Reset the session role to the configured assume_role before a connection is made available to another borrower, and cover role changes followed by pool reuse.

testing_gaps: No test covers session role changes followed by returning and reusing a pooled connection.
